Definition: feminine of a presumed derivative from an obsolete primary; an olive (the tree or the fruit):--olive (berry, tree).
BiblicalUsage: The word elaía carries the sense of an olive tree, or its fruit. In Matthew 21:1, the text says "unto the mount of Olives." In Mark 11:1, the text says "at the mount of Olives."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe elaía shows us that creation is God's handiwork, and it still speaks of Him to anyone willing to look. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
